children: Camping World Holdings entered into an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement providing $175.0 million in senior secured mortgage loan facilities to refinance existing debt and enhance liquidity. The deal includes $132.8 million funded at closing and $42.2 million of delayed draw commitments available through February 25, 2031, with interest at term SOFR + 2.30% or base rate + 1.30% and a 0.20% fee on unused delayed draw. The facility amortizes 5% annually beginning September 30, 2026, matures August 25, 2031, and allows the company to request up to an additional $100.0 million subject to conditions.
